definitions.explanation: The complete dying out or destruction of living things such as organisms, species, or cells. Also used figuratively for the disappearance of cultures, traditions, or ideas. Used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{死滅|しめつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{高温|こうおん}→高温：14705_kouon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{加熱|かねつ}すれば→加熱する：19637_kanetsusuru⟧⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{死滅|しめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If heated at high temperatures, the virus will be destroyed.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{死滅|しめつ}し、⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The once-thriving civilization perished, and only ruins remained.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death) + {滅|めつ} (destroy, extinguish). Often used in scientific contexts to describe the complete elimination of microorganisms, cells, or species. Also used figuratively for civilizations or traditions. Commonly used as a suru verb ({死滅|しめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{死滅|しめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (bacteria die off)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{死滅|しめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be completely destroyed)
- {死滅|しめつ}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to kill off, to destroy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧: extinction — typically used for species dying out completely
- ⟦{消滅|しょうめつ}→消滅：13331_shoumetsu⟧: disappearance, extinction — broader term for things ceasing to exist
- ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧: sterilization — the deliberate act of killing bacteria
